title: [GMCP 203.042.06] Operations and evidence: Performance, capacity, fairness, and resource budgets
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-042-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Published latency, throughput, startup, memory, descriptor, CPU, disk and event-fanout budgets are enforced per server, tenant and gateway under representative and adversarial load. Admission control, backpressure and fair scheduling prevent noisy neighbors; benchmarks are reproducible across supported platforms; regression thresholds gate release; and overload degrades explicitly without deadlock or unbounded growth. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
